name: Long slash spear
notes: Halberd-derived shaft and narrow spear tip, outward length +40%; opaque dagger slash trails aligned by pose without scaling. 192px walk/slash frames, no thrust. Walking shaft normalized to 48 pixels to match extended slash poses; grip and rear shaft preserved. Six 192px hurt poses derived from the halberd fall, with a 48px shaft; final pose supplies the corpse overlay.

credits.notes: Modified halberd art for a long slash spear. Derivative distributed under CC-BY-SA 3.0.
Dagger motion trails extracted, recolored and aligned per pose with nearest-pixel rotation.
